author: Jesse Elliott
title: What to expect at Thursday's data center public discussion in Springfield - NewsBreak
text:
By Jesse Elliott ,
1 hours ago
SPRINGFIELD, Mo — The city's first public engagement session regarding data centers will take place on Thursday, August 27 from 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m., and a preview for what to expect was given today.
It will take place at Doubletree by Hilton. Public Information Officer Cora Scott gave an overview of the event. First talking about how it will flow. ""We are setting up six question prompt stations. At each station there will be a moderator, a subject matter expert, some support staff and a note taker."
Attendees will be assigned with a station to start off. Cora said "So when people come in, they're going to be assigned to one of those six stations just randomly. Everybody will experience each of those topics."
Cora also listed the structure of each prompt station, saying "You'll have a topic introduction. The subject matter expert will provide some information about that prompt for about five minutes. Then we'll do questions and answers."
Each of the prompt stations were designed based on community concerns that have been voiced. Some of the concerns listed were:
How can the city and city utilities safeguard customers from potential increases in electric utility costs as data centers consider locating here?
How can the city and see you protect community water resources in regards to both quality and quantity?
What can the city require to ensure safe operation of data centers and ancillary facilities?
What can the city do to ensure sound isn't an issue as it relates to potential data centers?
Would you like to see the benefit from additional revenue?
Cora says that attendees will not have to rotate from station to station themselves, but rather the prompt stations will move through each group so that everyone will experience all topics.
The next community engagement session following this one will take place on Tuesday, September 1 at the Library Center's Hatch Auditorium.
